title: Cerulean City
subtitle: Rival on Nugget Bridge, Bill's S.S. Ticket, Cascade Badge, Route 5

steps.text: Cerulean City, house north of the Pokémon Center: trade a Poliwhirl for Zynx the Jynx (holds Fab Mail). Optional.
Old man in the north-northwest house gives the Powder Jar (for Berry Crush minigame).
The Bike Shop wants $1,000,000. Come back with the Bike Voucher from the Vermilion Pokémon Fan Club (chapter 5) for a free Bicycle.
Walk north toward Nugget Bridge: Rival battle 3. Pidgeotto Lv.17, Abra Lv.16, Rattata Lv.15, starter Lv.18. Abra only Teleports. He gives you the Fame Checker afterwards.
Nugget Bridge (Route 24): five trainers in a row, then a Rocket Grunt who hands over a Nugget and offers you a job. Decline and beat him.
Route 25: winding path of trainers to Bill's Sea Cottage. Oddish, Abra, Kakuna, Metapod in the grass.
Bill's Sea Cottage: talk to the Pokémon (Bill), use the PC to turn him back, then talk to him for the S.S. Ticket.

Misty: Staryu Lv.18, Starmie Lv.21 (Water Pulse, Rapid Spin, Recover). Electric or Grass hits hard. Starmie is fast and bulky; Pikachu, Oddish, Bulbasaur or a Grass/Electric move on Nidoran works. Be Lv.20+.
Gym Leader Misty. Cascade Badge (Cut usable, obedience to Lv.30) and TM03 Water Pulse.
The policeman at the burglarized house (northeast) has moved: go through the house to the back yard and beat the Rocket Grunt. He gives up TM28 Dig.
Route 5 (south of Cerulean): the Day Care raises one Pokémon for money. Meowth and Pidgey around. The gate to Saffron is blocked by a thirsty guard until you have Tea (chapter 8).
Underground Path entrance building (Route 5): trade a Nidoran♂ for Ms. Nido, a Nidoran♀ (or the reverse if you have a female).
Underground Path (north-south tunnel) leads to Route 6. Seven hidden items respawn here over time; walk the whole length with the Itemfinder later.
